app.name: data2flow
app.tagline: Watching is over. Now it fixes itself.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: An AIoT platform that collects and analyzes indoor environment sensor data and controls equipment.

password.rule: At least 10 characters. Do not include your ID or email; leaked passwords and your last 3 passwords cannot be used.

passwordReset.title: Reset password
passwordReset.sent: If an account matches what you entered, we sent an email. The link is valid for 30 minutes.
passwordReset.logoutNotice: Changing it signs you out on every device.

signup.name: Name
signup.sent: We sent a confirmation email. After you click the link, your request waits for administrator approval.
signup.verified: Your email is confirmed. You can sign in after an administrator approves your request.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.summary: We collect your name, email, phone number (optional) and sign-in records to operate your account and send notifications.
privacy.intro: data2flow collects only the personal information needed to operate accounts and send notifications.

name.name: Name
name.purpose: Display on screens and as the actor in audit records

privacy.retention: Kept while the account is in use. Audit logs are kept for the organization's policy period (1 year by default).
privacy.deletion: When you leave or an administrator deletes the account, name, email and phone are anonymized and only activity records remain.

profile.emailHint: An administrator can change your email.
